answer: Proof of Personhood serves as a vital Sybil resistance mechanism, requiring agents to solve cryptographic puzzles that mirror human biometric uniqueness. By anchoring digital identities in verified physical attributes rather than an ivory tower of abstract credentials, the network forces an attacker to incur a prohibitive velvet tax in real-world authentication costs. This exhaustion of resources renders the creation of high-fidelity fake identities economically irrational compared to the value of honest participation.
